Fed & Policy Watch

Today is a post-FOMC liquidity and rates session: the verified Federal Reserve calendar places Commercial Paper at 1:00 PM ET and H.8/H.15 at 4:15 PM. With the September 15-16 meeting and press conference behind us, watch whether funding and duration markets confirm or reject the overnight ES strength.

SOFR is 3.62%, NFCI is -0.56, and MOVE is 76.22. No NYSE holiday or shortened session is listed for September 18.

Omissions and Watch

BLS omitted: the official September 2026 schedule returned HTTP 403/access denied, so CPI, PPI, employment, and labor releases are not asserted. No Census, EIA, or Treasury auction has a verified Sep 18 release time. Treasury note and bill auctions in the week ahead are omitted where refreshed TreasuryDirect records did not expose exact closing times. NAR is not required for the selected dates.

BEA has no September 18 release; its verified September 24 U.S. International Transactions release is included. MOVE 76.22 is calm below 80; NFCI -0.56 indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions.

Trading Strategy Note - ES Futures
Base Case

ES overnight 7733.00 is above the September 17 SPY close of 762.60. With no verified 8:30-10:30 AM macro release today, use the opening range and the 1:00 PM Commercial Paper release as liquidity checkpoints. SOFR 3.62%, MOVE 76.22, and 10Y 4.94% support a measured continuation bias while rates remain orderly.

Invalidation

A decisive ES break back through the overnight range with a sharp 10Y or VIX reversal, or MOVE reclaiming 100, invalidates the continuation setup. Avoid chasing strength if H.8/H.15 at 4:15 PM ET confirms a tightening impulse.
